review_type: Pocock specification axis — bounded Settings correction
scope: Specification and approved bounded Settings policy only. Naming and standards were not assessed.
requirement_refs: Spec:855-868 and 913-915 retain the 512 native audits, 324 layout-only cases, 836-case programme, and no audit exception.
Spec:1188-1205 and 1290-1295 require focused diagnostic evidence, an exact candidate, and a 22-case unchanged-candidate pilot before expansion.
Spec:1345-1355 requires valid native results, observed system settings, restoration, and no weakened accessibility assertions.
Spec:1414-1426 keeps untested settings pending and rejects inference from attachments alone.
Plan:33 and 61-65 retain existing failures and prohibit conversion of failed native results into passes.

Approved Bounded Settings Recovery policy requires a requested native setting with in-app verification, no guessed wait, at most two fresh-state inputs, retained first miss, final mismatch failure, and no Apple-defect exception.

assessment.subject: Bounded retry policy
assessment.rationale: The switch policy permits at most two taps. Each loop reads a fresh native switch value. A changed value succeeds; an unreadable value fails; a persistent mismatch after the second tap fails.

assessment.subject: Evidence retention and verification
assessment.rationale: Each input and result records requested state, observed state, attempt number, and frame. The first miss retains a named screenshot. The final mismatch retains another screenshot and fails with both final and first-attempt values. The wait observes the requested condition; it is not a guessed delay.

assessment.subject: Scope and audit integrity
assessment.rationale: The one-file UI-test change corrects Settings automation only. It changes no application behaviour, test matrix, audit handler, capture path, runner, dependency, service, or target acceptance minimum. It does not create an Apple-defect exception.

assessment.subject: Failure basis
assessment.rationale: The retained failure classifies the lost Bold Text input as an unresolved Settings automation or environment fault. This correction bounds recovery and preserves the failure path; it does not assert a known cause.

verdict: PASS — the bounded Settings correction preserves the requested verification, evidence, retry, and failure policy. No specification-scope leak or acceptance masking was found. This does not establish Apple causation, native success, pilot success, or final application acceptance.
reported_check_status: The retained policy script reports 18 boundary checks passed. The native on/off run was active during review and was not treated as complete.
retained_limitations: The previous c0 pilot failed after five cases while setting Bold Text off. That result remains a failure record, not pilot credit.
The 22-case pilot, complete 836-case programme, audit results, image inspection, and final delivery gates remain pending.
No source edit, native test, or simulator action was performed by this review.
